classification.difficultyReason: Four explicitly dimensioned rectangular prisms require the familiar six-face surface-area sum; the cube uses equality marks and decimal arithmetic adds no new strategy.

content.prompt: Calculate the surface area of each prism.

spec.description: Explicit physical rectangular prism and source viewing relationship; closed six faces. All supplied dimensions/equality marks retained, ordinary ink black.
spec.answerVisibility: Original givens only; no areas added.

answer.worked:
All three marked dimensions are 5 cm, so
$$\begin{aligned}S&=6(5^2)\\&=150\text{ cm}^2.\end{aligned}$$

answer.worked:
Add the six rectangular faces in three equal pairs:
$$\begin{aligned}S&=2(12\times10+12\times5+10\times5)\\&=2(120+60+50)\\&=460\text{ cm}^2.\end{aligned}$$
